bug.title: Tool arguments can reach execution with mutually exclusive fields
bug.summary: A tool call has been observed with pages together with offset or limit. The repair must distinguish CSSwitch schema or reducer corruption from already-invalid upstream output and must never guess which field to delete.

basis: user-reported pages and offset/limit mutual-exclusion error

reproduction.state: historical-observed; exact current-target source red pending
steps: Use a fixed original tool input schema in which pages conflicts with offset and limit.
Exercise schema conversion before upstream, streamed/done argument reduction, and already-invalid upstream output as three separate fixtures.
Assert that CSSwitch-originated corruption is repaired at its seam and upstream-invalid arguments are not forwarded to Science.
Assert a bounded typed protocol error and unchanged original schema; do not delete a field heuristically.
reproduction.observed: The reported failure says pages and offset/limit are mutually exclusive and may arise while converting a response to Anthropic tool-call form.

confirmed_facts.statement: The mutual-exclusion error text was reported by the user during v0.8.3 planning.

hypotheses.statement: CSSwitch may corrupt the schema before upstream or corrupt arguments while merging stream and done events.
The upstream model may already have produced schema-invalid arguments that CSSwitch preserved exactly.
